description: Defines classes and structures for managing front panel indicators, blinking info, and related functionalities in a plugin-based system within the WPEFramework. Includes class declarations for CFrontPanel, BlinkInfo, and related enums and structs.

classes.name: BlinkInfo
classes.description: Represents blinking information associated with a front panel, including timing and comparison operators.

classes.name: CFrontPanel
classes.description: Manages front panel indicators, brightness, blinking, and preferences; singleton pattern.

methods.name: addEventObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer for front panel events.

methods.name: removeEventObserver
methods.description: Removes an observer for front panel events.

methods.name: setBrightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness level of the front panel.

methods.name: powerOffLed
methods.description: Turns off a specific LED indicator.

methods.name: powerOnLed
methods.description: Turns on a specific LED indicator.

methods.name: getPreferences
methods.description: Retrieves current preferences as a JsonObject.

methods.name: setLED
methods.description: Sets LED state based on blink info.

methods.name: setBlink
methods.description: Sets blinking pattern based on blink info.

methods.name: is24HourClock
methods.description: Checks if 24-hour clock mode is enabled.

methods.name: startBlinkTimer
methods.description: Starts blink timer with specified repeats.

methods.name: setBlinkLed
methods.description: Sets the LED to blink with specified info.
